The Christmas market in Wrocław has topped a new international ranking compiled by British currency exchange provider Sainsbury’s Travel Money, outperforming the festive markets of Riga, Prague and Budapest. The recognition follows Gdańsk’s success in securing the title of Europe’s best Christmas market for 2025.
